title: Pioneering Parental Leave: The History of GYES
grammar: Time-lapse and anteriority postpositions with múltával and elteltével ('after the lapse of')
goal: I can explain the significance of the 1967 introduction of the child-care allowance (GYES) in Hungarian social history.
I can use múltával and elteltével to express temporal lapse and deferred outcomes in formal Hungarian.
I can describe maternity leave, employment security, and state family benefits using appropriate terms.
